scope.subject: MATHEMATICAL_RESULTS_GUIDE.md
scope.purpose: bind one exact current Ubuntu hosted PDF observation for the source-specific cross-toolchain dispatcher

selected_profile_facts: exact Pandoc version and executable digest
exact LuaHBTeX version and executable digest
canonical command and resolved executable paths
per_run_custody_facts: each endpoint capture reads a descriptor-stable regular single-link file
the pre-build and post-build tuples agree on recorded paths, versions, lengths, digests, ownership, mode, and writability facts
adjudication.forbidden_selector: the lualatex.fmt length or SHA-256 must not select a comparison profile
adjudication.reason: four observed hosted format snapshots differ while three logged guide builds and both retained artifacts have the same guide SHA-256
adjudication.candidate_relation: a candidate must equal the retained fixture byte-for-byte or differ only in the strict duplicated final-trailer ID payloads, and both complete strict typed structure reports must agree
adjudication.exact_mode_boundary: same-toolchain exact mode remains a strict raw byte comparison and does not depend on this fixture or exception relation
adjudication.legacy_boundary: the Pandoc 3.1.3 font-resource alpha profile remains separate and cannot be selected for this Pandoc 3.10.2 producer

custody_boundaries: the two diagnostic commits and their temporary workflow edits are evidence-generation machinery and must not be merged into the publication branch
the tracked PDF is byte-bound to the two extracted hosted artifacts; the GitHub artifact ZIP bytes and complete runner filesystem were not retained
the second subject-job log records producer facts, but this receipt is not a transparency log or an authenticity attestation
the kpsewhich path, bytes, and digest are per-run custody evidence only; no retained expected kpsewhich digest exists, so the selector does not authenticate kpsewhich across runs
the varying format snapshots are evidence against format-hash profile selection, not evidence that TeX format bytes are irrelevant to arbitrary documents
pre-build and post-build tuple equality is not inode equality, an atomic filesystem snapshot, or proof that a selected executable could not change and be restored between endpoint captures
the raw-profile comparator trusts the outer hash-pinned pypdf wheel installation and additionally binds its version, external initializer path and bytes, and runtime stability
the result is source-specific and does not establish general Pandoc, TeX Live, renderer, operating-system, or future-run equivalence
the result does not establish PDF/UA conformance, mathematical correctness, estimator validity, statistical validity, scientific novelty, or application suitability
